author: OpenWeather <info@openweathermap.org>
description:
https://openweathermap.org/
OpenWeather will be exhibiting at E-World 2026 (https://e-world-essen.com/en/) , February 10–12, at stand GA-44.

We’ll be demonstrating how our Integrated Forecasting & Risk Management solutions help energy teams reduce uncertainty and operational risk. If you’re attending, it would be a pleasure to meet.

Below is what we’ll be presenting:

Renewables forecasting suite for wind and solar generation
Site-level wind and solar forecasts from minutes to weeks ahead for operations.
✅ Built for dispatch and grid stability
✅ Point forecast plus uncertainty ranges for confident planning
✅ Real-time change alerts for ramps and fast-moving weather shifts

Weather risk and operations suite with alerts and impact intelligence
✅ Extreme weather alerts and localized impact insights for grids and critical infrastructure
✅ Early warnings for storms, thresholds, and high-impact conditions
✅ Local risk views to protect assets and reduce disruption
✅ Meteor
title: Heading to E-World?
